name: Himuro Chitose
source:
A senior who aims to become a profiler. She has good analytical skills but cannot read other people's emotions very well. Lives in the same apartment as Toono.

[spoiler]Her parents were murdered while she was confined in a closet. Tonoo managed to talk to her on the scene and recruited her to Mushikui afterwards.[/spoiler]
